name: Cheshire West and Chester

licensing.selective: No selective licensing scheme is listed on the council's website.
licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing: only mandatory licensing of HMOs with five or more unrelated people sharing. Accredited landlords get 10% off the HMO licence fee.

neighbourhoods.name: Chester city centre
neighbourhoods.housing: Georgian and Victorian townhouses, many split into flats, with modern apartment blocks along the river and canal.

neighbourhoods.name: Hoole
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian and Edwardian terraces, popular with young professionals and students.

neighbourhoods.name: Handbridge and Curzon Park
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian terraces and larger period villas just south of the River Dee.

neighbourhoods.name: Ellesmere Port
neighbourhoods.housing: Post-war council-built estates, inter-war semis and newer estates near the motorway.

neighbourhoods.name: Northwich
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian terraces and black-and-white revival buildings in the centre, with post-war and modern estates around it.

neighbourhoods.name: Winsford
neighbourhoods.housing: Mainly 1960s and 1970s overspill estates with newer housing on the edges.

neighbourhoods.name: Frodsham
neighbourhoods.housing: Period cottages and townhouses along the main street, with semis and detached homes on the hillside.

neighbourhoods.name: Neston and Parkgate
neighbourhoods.housing: Older cottages and seafront houses in Parkgate, with suburban semis and detached homes in Neston.

neighbourhoods.name: Tarporley
neighbourhoods.housing: A village of brick and sandstone cottages and larger detached homes surrounded by farmland.

housing: The borough mixes the historic city of Chester with the industrial towns of Ellesmere Port, Northwich and Winsford and a large rural area. Chester's private rented sector is busy, with University of Chester students and young professionals renting Victorian terraces in Hoole, Boughton and Garden Quarter, plus HMOs and city-centre flats. Ellesmere Port and Winsford have large post-war estates, with former council homes now often let privately. Rural lets include farm cottages and sandstone village houses across the Cheshire Plain.
checkinTips: Student HMOs near the University of Chester: photograph each bedroom's lock and furniture, the fire doors and alarms, and the shared kitchen and bathroom separately.
Georgian and Victorian conversions in central Chester: check sash windows, shared hallway condition and any intercom or entry fob counts.
Riverside and canal-side flats: note any damp or condensation, balcony condition and allocated parking or bike store fobs.
Former council houses in Ellesmere Port and Winsford: photograph gardens, fences, sheds and the boiler and consumer unit.
Rural sandstone cottages: record oil tank levels, septic tank or private water supply, wood burners and any damp on solid walls.
Northwich has a history of salt-related subsidence: photograph any cracks in walls and around door and window frames.
tenantHelp: Tenants can contact the council's Private Rented Sector Service about disrepair, unsafe conditions or a landlord who won't carry out repairs.
